verdict.rationale: Clara documents a public REST API covering cards, transactions, users and invoices. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema, which a probe confirmed is live (HTTP 200 at openapi.json). The docs also include code examples, dashboard-managed credentials, a sandbox, and llms-api.txt for code generation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API beyond docs and endpoint probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Clara API gives you programmatic control over every aspect of corporate spend management — issue and manage cards, retrieve transactions, handle users, process invoices
Canonical docs-derived OpenAPI 3.1 schema for typed clients, function calling, schema inspection, and Postman import
REST API for programmatic access to corporate cards, transactions, users, invoices, and spend management across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.clara.team/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
